edge_identity.parent_mechanism: Binance Spot Block Matching cost reduction for an independently required large bilateral Spot trade
edge_identity.public_follow_up: One nonoverlapping time-triggered observation of already-settled public block-trade prices against causal pre-trade public best quotes.
edge_identity.scope: BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, and SOLUSDT on the public market-data-only WebSocket domain.

trigger_adjudication.reason: The current UTC instant was later than the literal nonoverlapping not-before boundary. No earlier-change exception was used.

current_primary_source_reuse.why_no_source_refresh: The retry trigger was elapsed time, not a source change. The exact official stream, payload, domain, rollout, and fee evidence was already hash-bound, so another documentation GET would add cost without changing the question.

local_preflight.methodology_correction: Verify the repository runtime and required transport dependency before invoking a frozen one-use runner. A pre-import failure is not a consumed venue request, but it is avoidable operator overhead and remains journaled.

frozen_capture.source_continuity: The three ordinary ticker streams delivered through the frozen duration. No transport close, reconnect, unexpected stream, or unexpected event occurred.

cumulative_public_observation.allowed_inference: No recurrent public BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, or SOLUSDT block-trade flow was observed in either complete window.
cumulative_public_observation.prohibited_inference: This does not prove the production stream, private Block Matching capacity, whitelist access, future event rate, or future price concession is zero.

economic_adjudication.material_follow_up_gate: All three target events must be analyzable and at least three distinct block IDs in one fixed symbol-and-side bucket must have a strictly positive lower-bound saving after the 2.5-bps block fee against an optimistically zero-fee causal public best quote.
economic_adjudication.reason: The second exact complete capture also contained zero blockTrade events, so there was no price, quantity, side, causal quote join, or economic row to evaluate.

efficiency_adjudication.reason: Two complete nonoverlapping windows retained 4,100 healthy ticker messages but zero block events and zero economic rows. Repeating the same passive question daily would spend operator time and storage without a changed mechanism or observed public event.
efficiency_adjudication.earlier_reopening_requires: A material official stream, fee, pair, whitelist, settlement, block-volume, or observed public-event change.

retry_trigger: Do not repeat a time-only public blockTrade observation before 2026-09-06T03:47:16.3134381Z. Reopen earlier only on a material official stream, fee, pair, whitelist, settlement, block-volume, or observed public-event change. The parent candidate may still advance under its existing conjunctive trigger: both designated credentials, explicit signed read-only authority, an independently planned legitimate large bilateral master-account Spot trade, existing whitelist, authentic counterparty, and frozen exact pair, quantity, side, and decision time. Every trade, settlement, contact, or account mutation requires separate explicit authority.
